_about: Three pilot hospitals for Kindred Snap. Patients and bills in this repository are synthetic; the policy fields below are each hospital's own published financial-assistance policy as captured in the Waive atlas (CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/Fluffy-SHIBAINU/waive), quoted verbatim with the dated source. State transition notes come from a 2026-11-09 web check and carry their own confidence; verify statute text before quoting.

2026.note: Read from the ASPE page on 2026-11-09; Federal Register 2026-00755 (2026-01-15) not fetched directly.

transition.law: AB 1312 (Stats. 2025, Ch. 450), Health & Safety Code 127406 et seq.
transition.what_changes: Hospitals must screen patients and presume financial-assistance eligibility under a written screening process, without requiring an application.
transition.confidence: medium (HCAI summary; chaptered text not opened)

free_care_max_fpl.quote: Charity Care will be made available to patients receiving medically necessary procedures and whose income is at or below 400% of the current year’s federal poverty level (FPL).

discount_tiers.quote: Attachment B Financial Assistance for Charity Care or Discount Payment by Federal Poverty Guidelines To find your Federal Poverty Level percentage (“FPL%”) and for updated annual salary amounts by family size ranges, visit the Organization’s website at https://www.cedars-sinai.org/billing-insurance-records/help-paying-your-bill.html The Organization uses the following Federal Poverty Level (“FPL”) and insurance guidelines to determine a discount: Charity Care Discount Payment FPL % 400% 450% 500% 550% 600% Uninsured 100% 95% 90% 85% 85%

insured_patients_covered.quote: Patients whose income ranges between 401%–600 % of the FPL also qualify for a Discount Payment, using a sliding scale based on family size, income level and insurance status.

documents_required.quote: Along with the application, please provide a copy of at least one of the following items as your proof of income. If you are married or have lived with a significant other for 6 months or longer, they will also need to provide a copy of at least one of the following items as proof of their income before the application can be processed. • Copies of 3 most recent paystubs from employer • Copies of most recent yearly tax return (if self-employed, include all schedules) • Social Security and/or Pension Retirement Award Letter • Parent or Guardian’s most recent yearly tax return, if applicant is a dependent listed on their tax form and under the age 25 • Other income validation documents • Copies of bank statements from last 3 months • Copy of receipt of unemployment benefits I Finally, please also provide documentation as proof of your outstanding monthly medical and pharmacy/drug costs.

value.detail: by visiting a Financial Counselor between the hours of 8am-5pm at any of the following locations: (a) NYU Langone Hospital Tisch: 550 First Avenue, MSB 2-100A, New York, NY 10016; (b) NYU Langone Hospital – Brooklyn 150 55th Street, Suite 2840, Brooklyn, NY 11220; (c) NYU Langone Hospital – Long Island 131 Mineola Boulevard, Suite 105, Mineola, NY 11501 or Admitting Office 259 First Street Mineola, NY 11501; or (d) NYU Langone Hospital – Suffolk 101 Hospital Road, Room NW 1011, Patchogue, NY 11772.

submit_methods.quote: If you have questions or need help completing the application, please call Financial Counseling Services at (888) 279-1364.

documents_required.quote:
Acceptable documentation of income may include any of the following: 
• Most Recent 1040 Tax Return
• Recent and consecutive pay stubs (Requires 3-4)
• W2 Forms
• 1099 forms for self-employed applicants
• Employer income letter
• Unemployment benefit documentation, notarized letter attesting to unemployment income, or furlough or employment termination letters
• Current school transcript for full-time students
• Documentation of pension income, or 401(k) or IRA distributions
• Income verification from public assistance, income verification from disability, or Social Security benefit verification letters
• Income verification from alimony, or income verification from child support
• Other supporting documentation may be considered on a case-by-case basis

phone.quote: Speak with a financial counselor for free and confidential assistance by calling [888-279-1364](tel:888-279-1364), available Monday through Friday, 8:00AM to 5:00PM.

hours.quote: Applications are available on the NYU Langone Health website (see https://nyulangone.org/insurance-billing-financial-assistance; go to “Patient Financial Counselors and Financial Assistance for Hospital Bills” and click on “financial assistance application”) or by visiting a Financial Counselor at NYU Langone Hospitals (Tisch): Skirball lobby (560 First Avenue, Rm SK, tel: 866-486-9847) or NYU Langone Hospital- Brooklyn (150 55th Street, Suite 2-40, tel: 718-630-6252) between the hours of 8 am to 5 pm.
